name: m5-unreachable-prof
description: Allocation and CPU profile of retronym/scala#200 against its base, to attribute the result of `m5-unreachable-ab` by site. One fork per build and corpus. Not a timing comparison.

Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); corpora compiled plainly, where unreachable-code removal is the only optimiser pass on. Patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), 8G heap. scala: single-shot 4+4 ops; scalap: 20+20 x 2 s.

variantDescriptions.pr: [retronym/scala#200](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/200): don't emit code codegen can tell is unreached, and skip unreachable-code analysis for methods with nothing to remove
